whyItMatters: A secret committed in this file is readable by everyone with repository access and lives on in history after removal. This rule reads a literal password in `settings.xml`.
actions: Remove the literal, rotate the credential and inject it from the CI secret store at run time. Specifically: fix a literal password in `settings.xml`.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm settings.xml no longer carries a literal password in `settings.xml`.
